exposure: Red blood cell membrane (RBCM) arachidonic acid (ARA) levels
Red blood cell membrane (RBCM) docosahexaenoic acid (DHA) levels
outcome: Retinopathy of prematurity (ROP) severity (no ROP, type 2 ROP, type 1 ROP)
cohort: The study included preterm infants divided into groups based on ROP severity.
finding: Infants with severe ROP have lower levels of red blood cell membrane ARA and DHA compared to infants without ROP, and higher ARA levels were associated with a reduction in any ROP.
followup_time: First month of life (observations at week 1 and week 2)
